# Storage Admin

## GET `/api/v1/admin/storage/accounts`
List account usage and effective limits
- operationId: `listStorageAccounts`
- Params: `query:page (integer)`, `query:limit (integer)`, `query:q (string)`, `query:overQuota (string)`
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → StorageAccountListResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse

## GET `/api/v1/admin/storage/policies`
List configurable storage policies
- operationId: `listStoragePolicies`
- Params: `query:page (integer)`, `query:limit (integer)`, `query:active (string)`
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → StoragePolicyListResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse

## PATCH `/api/v1/admin/storage/policies/{id}`
Update policy with optimistic version
- operationId: `updateStoragePolicy`
- Params: `path:id* (string)`
- Request: `UpdateStoragePolicyRequest` (required)
- Responses: `200` → StoragePolicyResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse, `404` → ErrorResponse, `409` → ErrorResponse, `423` → ErrorResponse

## POST `/api/v1/admin/storage/accounts/{userId}/adjustments`
Grant or remove audited account quota bytes
- operationId: `createStorageAdjustment`
- Params: `path:userId* (string)`
- Request: `CreateStorageAdjustmentRequest` (required)
- Responses: `201` → StorageAdjustmentResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse, `409` → ErrorResponse, `423` → ErrorResponse

## GET `/api/v1/admin/storage/adjustments`
List immutable Admin quota adjustments
- operationId: `listStorageAdjustments`
- Params: `query:page (integer)`, `query:limit (integer)`, `query:userId (string)`
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → StorageAdjustmentListResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse
